استوحين (form X)
# اِسْتَوْحَيْنَ (istawḥayna) /is.taw.ħaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَوْحَى (istawḥā)
# اُسْتُوحِينَ (ustūḥīna) /us.tuː.ħiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْحَى (istawḥā)
# اِسْتَوْحِينَ (istawḥīna) /is.taw.ħiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْحَى (istawḥā)
